scope.mode: read-only source/data audit; one new external report
scope.concurrentChange: Root is adding opt-in read diagnostics in resource-pack. Strict full-pack authorization remains unchanged; new profiling implementation/tests are owned and reported by Root, not certified by this audit.

target.globalRegions: Only report actually measured regions/routes; no worldwide SLA inferred from one Windows host.
target.timing: Single continuous D0 through actual authenticated world render, controls enabled and normal authoritative command ACK. Include all actual waits; do not substitute login/Healthy or deduct operator/network waits.

dataProvenance.kind: read-only remeasurement of preserved R19 signed catalog/artifacts, separate from current source working tree

caveats: 20 explicit startup resources and 20 login art resources are not the full play closure; wallet/character selection/HUD/actors/effects/sounds/locale and actual map dependencies must be added.
Prefix totals are inventory measurements, not assertions that every file in a prefix is needed at boot.

Theoretical transfer times use declared raw sizes, no latency, setup, verification, decompression, installation, human auth, GPU or health wait. New encoded transport must budget its separately authenticated wire sizes.
No complete per-map/entity/skill/locale closure has been proven yet; request-time read profiles provide observational lower bounds only.

blockers.fact: Game authenticates selected generation then opens every catalog pack, full-file hashes and validates every pack header/index and every catalog locator before mounting. Missing any object aborts. open_profiled retains this contract.
blockers.impact: 34 objects /1,069,036,665 raw pack bytes are a launch prerequisite. Updater-side full checks add their own earlier gates; see the separate updater audit.

blockers.fact: Fresh unique content is grouped in digest/BTreeMap order to a 32MiB target, 64MiB hard cap. Assets used together are dispersed. Existing build(previous) preserves old locators and reuses packs; it is not a full repack every update.
blockers.impact: 16.64MB explicit startup needs 533MB existing objects; direct startup+login art 19.22MB spans26 objects/860.71MB. Allowing missing outside scope alone is insufficient.
blockers.requiredChange: A signed boot/domain/map placement policy must intentionally place required content compactly. Existing previous-locator reuse must not accidentally prevent that selected regrouping. Unchanged background packs and aliases should still reuse authenticated content.

blockers.fact: Startup reads20 resources, including11.32MB native keyed index and3.40MB entity index, and hard-decodes map0 before constructing the Bevy app. Full catalog itself is68.67MB. Keyed index covers209 mapFileNames; map gz inventory contains1620 entries.
blockers.requiredChange: V2 bootstrap readiness must be an authenticated materialized scope, not merely exists(logicalPath). Keep full catalog first if the measured budget permits; later signed shard roots can reduce metadata. Initial actual character destination must drive per-map scope instead of declaring map0 means all scenes ready.

blockers.fact: Pack reads return Result internally but public assets APIs collapse errors to Option. Mounted-reader errors poison sticky FAILURE. Geometry/pixel caches can retain None. This currently assumes a fully materialized store.
blockers.requiredChange: Distinguish authenticated NotInCatalog, DeclaredNotResident, Pending, Available and IntegrityFailure. Network/pending must not become permanent None or poison the generation; undeclared/mismatched bytes never become optional. Invalidate transient caches/reactively retry when the exact requested resource becomes available.

blockers.fact: Incomplete animation families fall back to the base frame; missing unresolved base frames are skipped and detailed missing reports are trace-only. Some nonempty partial map state can still return Some. Missing whole render state emits an explicit disabled destination, but early has_local_map_atlas=false returns without emitting it.
blockers.requiredChange: Streaming missing residency must never select a different art path, silently skip terrain/actors, hold a stale prior map, or count partial content as a completed scene. Keep authored visual fallback separate from Pending. Gate destination presentation/input on the signed scope, explicit loading/failure UI and all required GPU dependencies.

blockers.fact: Current readiness proves composed, visible login controls, glyphs and loaded login images, and updater then waits10s. It does not prove an authenticated map or an authoritative action. report_interactive_login returns immediately after ready_sent, so later sticky resource errors do not use that handler's pre-ready exit path.
blockers.requiredChange: Retain loginReady and10s code health. Add a separate WorldInteractive receipt bound to current map/epoch/owner revision/rendered dependencies and input readiness. Continuous runtime asset error handling must remain active after login health.

blockers.fact: Loose/development fallback asynchronously downloads pathname-addressed data without the signed pack/resource checks. Packed mode explicitly never enters this path.
blockers.requiredChange: Do not re-enable that fallback for streaming production. Add a new authenticated scheduler/store path with fixed trusted resource identities and approved immutable transport locations.

minimumCompleteDesign.firstVersion: New opt-in signed generation/content-profile capability with full authenticated catalog + signed required boot/per-map scopes + compact domain packing + PartialStore. Preserve the existing full V1 path; do not reinterpret existing missing-pack errors as permission.

bind: logical path + resourceSHA + byte size + locator
signedScope.authorization: Declared content remains the namespace. Absence from local storage is permitted only by the authenticated V2 materialization contract; it does not authorize missing currently required content.

hydration.api: Keep exists() as signed logical declaration, add explicit availability and require_scope()/async read APIs.
hydration.transport: Deduplicate concurrent requests, prioritize boot/current map/visible actors/combat over background completion, bounded workers/memory/disk, bounded normal-TLS retry/resume per the updater contract, no blocking network on Bevy main thread.
hydration.publication: Download outside admitted paths, verify exact size/hash/index before admission, atomic create-only publication, retain immutable handles/ancestor protections, prevent GC of mounted or pending active scopes.
hydration.fullCompletion: Background can hydrate every original pack and publish a separate complete-content receipt only after full verification; code Healthy is not full-content completion.

scopeContents: Boot code/config/catalog/global metadata, actually selected locale/fonts, complete normal login/wallet/character UI dependencies and every interactive state used in acceptance.
Actual target map layout/collision/lighting/pathing, all needed terrain/keyed images and complete animation families, HUD/cursors/item/skill presentation needed immediately.
Player class/gender/equipment body/weapon/wings/pet states; map NPC/monster idle/walk/combat/death/effects/audio dependencies and a declared policy for remote-player cosmetics/new AOI entities.

An authenticated character-list/scene-offer can identify the destination scope before committing entry. Otherwise MapChange must hold explicit loading/input gates until scope is ready; never assume map0 for every resumed character.

runtime.bevy: PackedAssetReader::read is already async; it can await a verified scheduler result. Synchronous parser/atlas code needs staged readiness and retry notification rather than blocking or returning an undifferentiated None.
runtime.scene: Use generation+mapFileName+scene/session epoch+owner revision identity. New destination invalidates old completion ACK; no previous-map image or old load result satisfies a new scene.
runtime.missingPresentation: Visible loading/error status and retry/cancel; no invisible enemy, skipped map cell, arbitrary default image or silently wrong cosmetic. Anything essential keeps WorldInteractive false and relevant controls disabled.
runtime.authority: Preserve personal Session vs shared authoritative Zone. Client resource readiness cannot invent movement, teleport, occupancy or save transforms. A server scene-offer/readiness extension needs its own synchronous lifecycle/reconnect/save contract review.

minimumCompleteDesign.updates: Stage new generation B and its required active scope while A remains authentic/usable; no hot replacement of A's mounted catalog or source. Root's updater audit owns atomic selector/health/rollback/GC details. Any300s update claim is bounded by the actual changed required wire bytes plus verification/install/world-ready cost.
optionalLater: Authenticated per-resource range/resource-CAS hydration could avoid whole-pack amplification: signed resource SHA/size authenticates exact bytes, strict206/Content-Range/length and bounds, no accepting a full200 blob as a tiny resource, coalesce bounded ranges, rehash before decode. This requires a distinct protocol/security proof and is not a shortcut through V1 read_pack.

Signed catalog shards/root manifest can avoid fetching/parsing68.67MB upfront; keep full namespace/source/alias/collision validation and membership proofs. Not necessary for the smallest first implementation if actual compact boot budget already fits.
minimumCompleteDesign.compatibility: Negotiate a new capability/schema/minEngine safely, while retaining a usable old engine/healthy-generation route. Old Game SDKs restrict Engine.version<=their compiled ENGINE_VERSION; blindly replacing global activeEngine with a higher version can break old play/rollback. Never widen old parsers or fake Healthy/previous to bypass this.

diagnosticsIntegrationAuthorizedNext.status: Proposal only at this report; Root has now assigned a separate minimal Game integration, to be implemented and tested after writing this audit.
diagnosticsIntegrationAuthorizedNext.gameOpen: generation_launch::load_inner uses open_profiled only when the existing NativeCaptureConfig::from_env gate accepts MIR2_NATIVE_CAPTURE_DIR; enable before verify_packed_startup_assets. Default remains ordinary open, no profile.
diagnosticsIntegrationAuthorizedNext.requestFreeze: capture.rs::capture_request freezes the mounted store's snapshot into private NativeCaptureRequest at the same request as world/build/scene; never take a later live snapshot in GPU readback completion.
diagnosticsIntegrationAuthorizedNext.separateDiagnostic: Write sibling .resource-reads.json binding final PNG SHA, scene, captured_at/frame, authenticated generation/catalog and bounded snapshot. Create-only/fsync/atomic discipline; do not modify existing PNG/capture-v1 schema or loosen existing eligibility/completion marker truth.
diagnosticsIntegrationAuthorizedNext.limitations: Successful read counts are a cumulative observational lower bound, not complete boot authorization. Prefetch/history can overcount a frame; unseen maps/actions/locales can undercount a release. Overflow/poison recovery or absent profile evidence cannot be hidden or treated as completeness.
diagnosticsIntegrationAuthorizedNext.privacy: Only logical resource paths, hashes/counts/source identifiers; no raw resource bodies, account/session blobs, QR challenges, access tokens, environment dump or credential-bearing URLs.

requiredValidationBeforeAnyClaim: Unit: V1 still refuses every missing/corrupt pack; V2 only mounts authenticated allowed partial scope and refuses missing required/undeclared content.
Tamper/path: catalog, scope, hash/size/index alias mismatch, noncanonical path, redirect/range mismatch, symlink/hardlink/ancestor replacement, partial/corrupt CAS, admission/GC race.
Async: single-flight, cancellation, interrupted/resumed fetch, transient failure/retry, permanent integrity failure, subscriber wakeup, no negative-cache poison, bounded memory/disk.

Scene: missing atlas page/animation member/NPC/effect after login gives explicit Pending or error and no playable/old-map ACK; real destination+epoch only; disconnected/relogin/saved-map transitions preserve Zone/save authority.

Closure matrix: normal authenticated new and resumed characters across supported maps/classes/genders/locales, real NPC/combat/equipment effects, window/scene changes, common and rare AOI entrants. Success-read traces plus static dependencies and missing-resource checks.

Performance: fresh client/no preload, original4CPU8GiB SSD/20Mbps baseline, continuous D0 to real WorldInteractive and normal command ACK. Preserve all failures and waits, byte counts, TLS/proxy/route, source/recipe/capability identity, normal exit. Actual regional routes only, both first install and subsequent update.

Diagnostic-only integration: capture disabled leaves no profile; valid capture enables before20 startup reads; success/failure counters correct; request snapshot is immutable across later reads; diagnostic/PNG hash pairing and create-only collision/error paths; existing capture-v1 truth unchanged. No GPU needed for these unit tests.
